scope: Additive factual preparation for the two newly final Week 9 late-window games. Each pair binds the official final, frozen kickoff ratings/H4, final inactive and transaction inventory, complete gamebook starters/substitutes/DNP, actual quarterback and specialist duties, and every printed injury/status/return annotation. Official snap counts, exact replacement allocations and immutable player-value bindings remain explicit. No started-game prediction, fair, carried rating or market field is changed.
estimationPolicy: Factual preparation only. Missing values and missing exposure are not zero. Gamebook participation does not prove replacement allocation, replacement quality or snap share. No new numerical method is authorized.
